subject: english
question:
Two figures given on the left side of (::) are related with some logic/rule/relation. Select the missing figure on the right side of (::) from the given alternatives based on the same logic/rule/relation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fc73ed1fa7d8fa10bfb7b534ce572aafcc60359b2c34a7992dc7319429342ce.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** The transformation is a **180-degree rotation** (or combined horizontal and vertical flip) of all elements within the square.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8fca8ba69908f87b86bb5b555531e5c99b1448542c286bf5df4fac59aa02f5b.png] 

**Here,**

**First Pair:** Numbers around the square are rotated 180°, so top-left moves to bottom-right, top-right moves to bottom-left, etc.

**Second Pair:** Apply the same rotation:

Top-left → bottom-right

Top-middle → bottom-middle

Top-right → bottom-left

Bottom-left → top-right

Bottom-middle → middle-top

Bottom-right → top-left

**Now, checking Options:**

Option 1 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b2e7980de72edfc1b14f0d5d7d3cd223ea40d0056219dd4753f5f16829207d3.png] 

– Incorrect placement 

**Option 2 ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5886da676ee81bef4b0641a6aad1fc144cebe60b64a67b2b62b9010def998519.png] 

– Symbols correctly rotated 

Option 3 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b83f45503b856afad0f26eaff60c269a009d5401a4557e3ee8d5fcd1b9a5ce1.png] 

– Incorrect letter placement 

Option 4 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d7ab7acb547f85c14db92a44ad4f0b0972c6a58bd683404554c0567c420fd2a.png] 

– Incorrect symbol orientation 

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
